description.zh: 定时提醒休息：小休看看远处，大休起来走走，可以设成必须休完
description.en: Reminds you to take breaks: look away for a short one, get up for a long one; can be made strict

description.zh: 离下次休息还有多久；现在休息、暂停、重新计时
description.en: Time to the next break; a break now, a pause, a new count

title.zh: 每隔多少分钟休息一次

hint.en: 2: short and long take turns; 0: no long breaks

hint.zh: 休息画面没有「跳过」「推迟」「暂停 1 小时」，长按 Esc 3 秒才能提前离开
hint.en: No Skip, Postpone or Pause 1 hour on the break screen; hold Esc for 3 seconds to leave early

hint.zh: 屏幕上方出现一个小条，可以推迟、跳过或暂停 1 小时；0：不提前
hint.en: A small bar at the top of the screen, with Postpone, Skip and Pause 1 hour; 0: none

hint.zh: 每次休息只能推迟一次

title.zh: 离开多少分钟算休息过
title.en: Away this many minutes counts as a break

hint.zh: 没碰键盘鼠标这么久，回来后重新计时
hint.en: No keyboard or mouse for this long: the count starts again when you are back

title.en: Not during full screen or Do not disturb

hint.zh: 玩游戏、放幻灯片、全屏看视频、开着勿扰时，等结束了再提醒；全屏开着的终端、远程桌面也算
hint.en: Games, slide shows, full-screen video, Do not disturb: the break waits until they end; a terminal or remote desktop in full screen counts too
